answer: By bonding stake to a per-epoch identity cost that decays with AMM slippage bounds, the protocol makes each new sybil a costly bet against the cooperative subgame-perfect equilibrium, so honest agents ride the tide of shared liquidity while forgers drown in rising collateral. No fable of free identities survives the dawn of dynamic staking equilibria, where replication is. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
